body:
### UTC Date & Time

[June 11, 2026, 11:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/june-11-2026/11am)

### Agenda

ACDC #180 — June 11, 2026 @ 11:00 UTC (trial time)
Devnet updates:
- Glamsterdam devnet-5 status. How is stability looking? Explain the bugs found by deathstar.
- What do client teams need right now? what can we help with?
- What is the plan for devnet-6?


Glamsterdam:
- Proposer Preferences API Specs — james-prysm: any remaining concerns on beacon-APIs PR https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/608?
- (Cayman) QUIC support & multiplexer transition — wemeetagain: cross-client status check needed. Lighthouse already https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/9365. 
- Discuss consensus-specs https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5330. Avoid network split — coordinate before going straight to QUIC vs yamux.
- Leobago would like to discuss a minor change to the beacon API regarding the deposits/validator endpoint.  Related blog post: [https://www.migalabs.io/blog/validator-states](https://www.migalabs.io/blog/validator-states)  PR: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/618

Hegota:
- (Raul) EIP-8243: # Batching Attestations at Source (github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11589


If time permits:
- EIP-8061 SFI (Increase exit/consolidation churn) — already implemented/tested since DevNet-1. Weak subjectivity parameters confirmed tunable. Straightforward SFI decision expected.
- EIP-8080 DFI (Exits use consolidation queue) — intent to DFI stated in #1794 


### Call Series

All Core Devs - Consensus

comments.body: any remaining concerns on https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/608  for proposer preferences beacon api specs

I'd like to get a pulse on QUIC support on all clients and discuss https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5330

I know that Lighthouse recently merged this PR to [disable mplex by default](https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/9365). In the past, discussion here around mplex deprecation led to "go straight to QUIC" instead of embracing yamux. We should coordinate here to avoid network split.

We would like to discuss a minor change to the beacon API regarding the deposits/validator endpoint.
Related blog post: https://www.migalabs.io/blog/validator-states
PR: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/618
we would like to talk about [EIP-8282](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11760) cc @wemeetagain

**Mascot needed for Glamsterdam upgrade**
🐜🦫🐝🦩🐹🐙🐻‍❄️🐩
Vote for your favorite

https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/mascot-needed-for-glamsterdam-upgrade/26008

I want to discuss some aspects w.r.t the builder-api:
1. Final call on https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/138, I ll be merging it after the call. We can update it if needed by raising PRs.
2. I want to talk about https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/162
3. How should we approach circuit breakers? Should we just specify that clients MUST fallback to self build and let the heuristics be impl dependent as today? like how we have in the bellatrix spec: https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/specs/bellatrix/validator.md?plain=1#L198
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
